dataset: user JAWS VTA dopamine inhibition authority
interpretation: Real VTA dopamine inhibition selectively weakens an observation-conditioned Active reward/belief coordinate and active observation value, while gross observation amount and Passive belief do not show the same acute endpoint. The effect survives a count/order-preserving null and a continuous no-reset replay.
bridge_role: This supplies a real intervention anchor for the Mouse Emulation Bridge: the model must represent a slow reward-credit state that changes under causal perturbation without reducing the phenomenon to immediate action suppression.
guardrails: Use corrected OFF/ON state labels from the accepted JAWS authority; do not infer laser state from filenames or raw day order.
Acute OFF->ON is the primary causal comparison. Normal->Full JAWS is session-scale supportive evidence with day/context differences.
Do not claim statistically established contingent-versus-noncontingent interaction specificity at the latent level.
Do not claim immediate next-observation policy suppression.
